active_cases.title: Write-boundary blocks a skill document edit
Write-boundary blocks a repository test edit
Ledger delta watermark is incremental
cmd:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile; p=pathlib.Path('skills/m2-dispatcher/scripts/m2_preflight.py');
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 h=pathlib.Path(d)/'goal'; h.mkdir(); l=h/'ledger.md'; l.write_text('## Events
- 2026-01-01T00:00:00+08:00 | EVT=READY | id=E0
'); subprocess.run(['python3',str(p),'ledger-delta','--handoff-dir',str(h),'--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); l.open('a').write('- 2026-01-01T00:00:01+08:00 | EVT=DONE | id=E1
'); r=subprocess.run(['python3',str(p),'ledger-delta','--handoff-dir',str(h),'--json'],capture_output=True,text=True); x=json.loads(r.stdout); print(json.dumps({'ok':r.returncode==0 and len(x['new_events'])==1,'delta_events':len(x['new_events'])}))

active_cases.title: Supersede clears a zombie goal
cmd:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile; p=pathlib.Path('skills/m2-dispatcher/scripts/m2_preflight.py');
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 h=pathlib.Path(d)/'old-goal'; h.mkdir(); (h/'ledger.md').write_text('# Goal
- status: in_progress

## Tasks
| ID | Status | Owner | PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | in_progress | writer | — |
| T2 | done | writer | — |

## Events
'); (h/'queue.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tasks':[{'task_id':'T1','status':'in_progress'},{'task_id':'T2','status':'done'}]})); r=subprocess.run(['python3',str(p),'supersede-goal','--old-handoff',str(h),'--new-goal','new-goal','--apply','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True); ledger=(h/'ledger.md').read_text(); q=json.loads((h/'queue.json').read_text()); x=json.loads(r.stdout); print(json.dumps({'ok':r.returncode==0 and x['cancelled_tasks']==['T1'] and 'EVT=GOAL_SUPERSEDED' in ledger and 'EVT=GOAL_DONE' in ledger and q['tasks'][0]['status']=='cancelled','zombie_cleared':not any(s in ledger for s in ('in_progress','active','planning'))}))
